name: Reflectance and Shading Decomposition Priors
definition: Reflectance is an inherent attribute of surfaces independent of illumination; shading represents brightness reflected from a point to the viewpoint.
summary: Reflectance and Shading Decomposition Priors enforce physical plausibility in neural radiance fields by decoupling color into material reflectance and shading, distinguishing itself by explicitly regularizing these intermediate components to mitigate scale ambiguity.
